verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud realtime/AI-agent platform like LiveKit, so the axis applies. The pack never documents retention periods, deletion APIs, or data-lifecycle settings. Related items (moving to self-hosted, egress recording to MP4/HLS, region-restricted telephony trunks) are adjacent features or user-side arrangements, not retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
